title: A planar constant-density piece at a nonzero point of a 2-dimensional minimizing cone has mass at least H² of the plane
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟₂(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P, with ∂C = 0 and a cone. Let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P, x ∈ Q with x ≠ 0, k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, and ε > 0. Suppose spt C ∩ B_ε(x) = Q ∩ B_ε(x) and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(x). Then there is ε' > 0 such that spt C ∩ B_ε'(x) = Q ∩ B_ε'(x), HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε'(x), and H²(W ∩ Q) ≤ M_W(C) for every open W ⊆ B_ε'(x). Here H² = μHE[2] and M_W = massOn.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → 1 ≤ k → x ∈ Q → x ≠ 0 → 0 < ε → C.support ∩ ball x ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε → HasMassDensity C y k) → ∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ C.support ∩ ball x ε' = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε' ∧ (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε' → HasMassDensity C y k) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball x ε' → μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) ≤ C.massOn W
